remarks: 1st Floor - no steps from street/front door. Walk to East Norwalk train station, Vets Park and SoNo in just a few minutes, get to Calf Pasture Beach, Shady Beach picnic area, Taylor Farm Park, Norwalk Cove Marina, Shorehaven Golf Club (and much more) in a 5-10 minute drive. Great new look; just freshly painted. Unit is in good condition - has good amount of natural light - full-size washer and dryer in unit - good storage space - Gas heat and cooking - 2 off-street parking spaces. 2nd BR is a junior size - poss den/office/walk-in closet.No pets/no smoking. Keybox on rear-deck door knob (behind storm door). Please remove shoes or wear shoe-covers while viewing property.
